answer: A jetty gate opens only on its pulse: each epoch the chain fires 36 pulses, one per jetty, and its operator has 90 seconds to pull it by a live hand. Two jetties per operator, so ten fakes need five hands at once, not one script. Bond is 90 POA, rising 55 per extra fake, so ten cost 3,375 POA; a missed pulse burns 30. Each pull needs three stranger signatures, each stranger signing at most twice, and the ledger checks pull time against the broadcast pulse. One hand pulling two gates in the same window voids both, so a voyage of ten fakes strands itself at the jetty it cannot staff.
